stories.title: Trump is expected to name intelligence chief Jay Clayton as his new AI czar
stories.reason: Clayton, who could keep his Director of National Intelligence post while taking on the role, would fill the vacancy left by venture capitalist David Sacks and is tasked with pushing AI development even as safety concerns mount after a string of high-profile incidents.

stories.title: More than 150,000 march in Madrid as housing protests sweep over 50 Spanish cities
stories.reason: The demonstrations followed parliament's rejection of decrees that would have restricted evictions and reined in investment funds buying up housing, galvanized by the eviction of an 87-year-old Madrid tenant facing a 275% rent increase.

stories.title: Russia strikes Kyiv's Northern Bridge, the second major bridge hit in two days
stories.reason: The strike damaged the road surface and trolleybus lines a day after the Southern Bridge was hit five times in 24 hours, with officials saying the attacks are effectively cutting the capital in two and causing severe traffic congestion across the city.

stories.title: Latvia's governing pro-Ukraine party leads a parliamentary election as populists make gains
stories.reason: Exit polls show PM Andris Kulbergs' centrist United List ahead with 35.6%, but the MAGA-style Latvia First party's 11.3% points to a fragmented Saeima where cost-of-living anger is cutting into consensus on defense spending amid perceived Russian threats.

stories.title: Google tests a 'Full Access' permission that would let Gemini Desktop control any file or app
stories.reason: The setting, spotted in testing, would let Gemini read, modify or delete files anywhere on a Mac and act through other apps without per-action approval, though it would still ask before purchases, account creation or changes to sensitive settings.

stories.title: Egypt to host a four-way summit with Eritrea, Somalia and Sudan as Horn of Africa tensions rise
stories.reason: El-Sisi will host Eritrean, Somali and Sudanese leaders in New Alamein days after Eritrea and Ethiopia severed diplomatic ties, with the talks centered on sovereignty, territorial integrity and Red Sea security as the region's conflicts increasingly intersect.

stories.title: Nigeria's private sector posts its strongest growth in more than four years
stories.reason: The PMI climbed to 56.4 in September from 54.3, with new orders and output rising at the fastest pace since February 2022 even as input costs accelerated to a three-month high on higher fuel and food prices.

stories.title: Meta open-sources 'Muse Gadgets' so developers can build their own hardware for its AI assistant
stories.reason: The released ESP32 firmware and Linux SDK let makers embed Muse into custom displays, sensors and controls, while a companion USB-C 'Home Link' device, shipping free to 5,000 subscribers, lets the assistant reach smart-home gear over a local network.
